name: ai-autocomplete
description: Fast AI code completion for self-hosted and cloud models. Autocomplete only: no chat, no agents, no telemetry.

aiAutocomplete.enabled.markdownDescription: Turn AI Autocomplete on or off: off stops completions and Next Edit together and keeps both backend choices. The status bar menu's **Turn off AI Autocomplete** sets it.

aiAutocomplete.backends.markdownDescription:
[Manage backends](command:aiAutocomplete.manageBackends)

Completion backends. Machine-scoped: only read from your user settings, never from a workspace, so a repository cannot redirect your code to another host. API keys are not stored here; use the **AI Autocomplete: Set API Key** command.

llama.cpp:
```json
{ "id": "local", "kind": "llamacpp", "baseUrl": "http://127.0.0.1:8012" }
```
Mistral Codestral:
```json
{ "id": "codestral", "kind": "mistral", "baseUrl": "https://codestral.mistral.ai", "model": "codestral-latest" }
```

id.description: Unique id: lowercase letters, digits and dashes.

hostFlavor.description: Server software, used to pick server-specific request options.

use.description: What the backend is used for. Missing means both.

completions.description: Completion settings for this backend; each key overrides the matching global setting.

template.description: FIM prompt template to use instead of the one detected from the model name.

contextTokens.description: Total context budget in tokens, split between prefix, suffix and extra context.

prefixLines.description: Lines of code before the cursor. The window start moves in steps of a quarter of this, so up to about 1.25× this many lines are sent.

suffixLines.description: Maximum lines of code after the cursor.

extraContext.description: Include snippets from other open files.

multiline.description: Whether completions may span several lines.

debounceMs.description: Delay in milliseconds before requesting a completion after typing.

thinking.description: How thinking is turned off for this backend's model on the chat prompt.

extraBody.description: Extra JSON fields merged into the request body.

aiAutocomplete.privacy.localOnly.markdownDescription: Refuse to send any request to a backend that does not resolve to a loopback or private-network address. A workspace, or any folder of a multi-root workspace, can turn this on but not off.

aiAutocomplete.completions.backend.markdownDescription: Id of the backend (from `#aiAutocomplete.backends#`) used for completions. Defaults to the first backend used for completions. May be set per workspace.

aiAutocomplete.completions.multiline.markdownDescription: Whether completions may span multiple lines. `auto` decides from the cursor position.

aiAutocomplete.completions.disableInLang.markdownDescription: Language ids in which completions are disabled.

aiAutocomplete.completions.disableInFile.markdownDescription: Glob patterns of files whose content is never sent and in which completions are disabled. Workspace and folder settings add patterns to this list; they cannot remove the ones from your user settings (or the defaults).

aiAutocomplete.completions.skipMidWord.markdownDescription: Do not trigger a completion when the cursor is in the middle of a word.

aiAutocomplete.completions.extraContext.markdownDescription: Include snippets from other open and recently edited files as extra context.

aiAutocomplete.completions.debounceMs.markdownDescription: Delay in milliseconds before requesting a completion after typing. `null` picks a default based on whether the backend is local.

aiAutocomplete.completions.maxTokens.markdownDescription: Maximum number of tokens to generate per completion. A `sampling.maxTokens` in `#aiAutocomplete.modelOverrides#` replaces it for matching models.

aiAutocomplete.completions.prefixLines.markdownDescription: Lines of code before the cursor. The window start moves in steps of a quarter of this, so up to about 1.25× this many lines are sent.

aiAutocomplete.completions.suffixLines.markdownDescription: Number of lines after the cursor sent as context.

aiAutocomplete.nextEdit.enabled.description: Show Next Edit suggestions when a Next Edit backend is chosen.

aiAutocomplete.nextEdit.backend.description: Backend for Next Edit suggestions (an id from aiAutocomplete.backends). Empty: Next Edit is off.

aiAutocomplete.nextEdit.display.description: How Next Edit suggestions are shown.
markdownEnumDescriptions: Native inline edits when the proposed API is enabled, otherwise decorations.
VS Code's own inline-edit view. Needs **Enable Native Next Edit UI** and a VS Code restart.
Editor decorations; works without the proposed API.

enumDescriptions: Picks the format by the model name.
Chat prompt, for general chat models such as Qwen on Strata.
Sweep next-edit models on a raw completions route.
Zeta 2.1 on a raw completions route.
aiAutocomplete.nextEdit.format.description: Prompt and answer format of Next Edit requests.

aiAutocomplete.nextEdit.timeoutMs.description: Deadline for one Next Edit request.

aiAutocomplete.nextEdit.regionLinesAbove.description: Lines above the cursor the model may rewrite. Not used by Zeta 2.1, which sizes its region by length.

aiAutocomplete.nextEdit.regionLinesBelow.description: Lines below the cursor the model may rewrite. Not used by Zeta 2.1, which sizes its region by length.

aiAutocomplete.nextEdit.historySize.description: Number of recent edit diffs sent to the model.

aiAutocomplete.nextEdit.contextBudget.description: Prompt budget in tokens, split between the file, the edit history and recently viewed snippets.

aiAutocomplete.local.llamaServerPath.markdownDescription: Path to `llama-server`. Empty: look on PATH and in the usual install places. Machine-scoped.

aiAutocomplete.local.modelsDir.markdownDescription: Folder for downloaded local models. Empty: the extension's own storage folder. Machine-scoped.

aiAutocomplete.local.modelsInMemory.markdownDescription: How many local models the server keeps loaded at once. Machine-scoped.

aiAutocomplete.local.models.markdownDescription: Your changes to the built-in local models and the models you added. Edit them on the Local Models page. Machine-scoped.

name.description: Model name, lowercase letters, digits, `.`, `_` and `-`.

revision.description: Commit hash the file is pinned to.

extraArgs.description: Extra llama-server arguments, as one command line.

aiAutocomplete.modelOverrides.markdownDescription:
Per-model overrides. Keys are regular expressions matched against the model name; values may set `fimTemplate`, `stop`, `sampling`, `thinking` and `extraBody`. Machine-scoped.

```json
{ "qwen.*coder": { "fimTemplate": "qwen", "stop": ["<|endoftext|>"] } }
```

aiAutocomplete.debug.logPrompts.markdownDescription: Write prompt and completion text to the output channel. Off by default because it contains your code. Timings, status codes and sizes are always logged at debug level.

walkthroughs.title: Get started with AI Autocomplete
walkthroughs.description: Pick a model, see your first completion and learn how your code stays private.

steps.title: Choose a model
steps.description:
Run a model on this machine, or connect a server you already run.
[Set Up Local Model](command:aiAutocomplete.setUpLocalModel)
[Connect a Server](command:aiAutocomplete.manageBackends?%7B%22add%22%3Atrue%7D)

media.altText: The Backends page listing configured backends

steps.title: See a completion
steps.description: Type in a code file. Grey ghost text appears after the cursor; press Tab to accept it. Press Alt+\ to ask for a suggestion on demand.

media.altText: Ghost text completing a line of code

steps.title: Try Next Edit
steps.description:
Pick a backend for Next Edit, then rename something. The next place that needs the same change is suggested: Tab jumps there and applies it.
[Select Next Edit Backend](command:aiAutocomplete.selectNextEditBackend)

media.altText: A Next Edit suggestion in the editor

steps.title: Keep code private
steps.description:
Nothing leaves your machine except requests to the backends you configure, and there is no telemetry.
[Local-only mode](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%22aiAutocomplete.privacy.localOnly%22)
[Excluded files](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%22aiAutocomplete.completions.disableInFiles%22)
